## 中文原文
午休的时候，你打算去茶水间接一杯热水。走到茶水间，发现饮水机没水了。你准备联系行政换桶装水，结果行政说新的水桶暂时还没送到。

## My translation
During the lunch break, I planned to grab a cup of hot water at the pantry.
When I was there, I found there was no water at all.
I asked administration for switching the empty bottle, but he said new bottles of water were not delivered yet.

## Revised version
During my lunch break, I went to the pantry to get a cup of hot water.
When I got there, the water dispenser was empty.
I asked the admin to replace the empty jug, but they said new water jugs hadn't been delivered yet.

## Key phrases
- during my lunch break, 固定搭配
- water dispenser，饮水机
- jugs, 桶装水水桶
